newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian capital plans new bond issue - report.
newsitem.headline: Estonian capital plans new bond issue - report.

text.p: Estonian capital city Tallinn plans a new bond issue worth 400 million kroons to refinance an issue last year, newspaper Bizness i Baltiya said on Wednesday.

Tallinn last year launched the first eurobond for Estonia when it set a 480 million kroon, three-year bond to raise funds for infrastructure investment. It was arranged by Japanese securities house Nomura.
The newspaper said that Tallinn city council hoped that the coupon on the new bond would not be higher than the six percent of the previous issue.
The maturity of the new issue is planned for 1999 but it wants to repay the biggest portions of the debt at the start of 2000, the newspaper added.
U.S. securities house Merryll Lynch and Chase Manhattan Bank as well as the biggest Estonian commercial banks hope to be chosen to arrange the issue, Bizness i Baltija added.
